reviews.review_text: The best thing I liked about the online MBA course at NMIMS was the extended course duration. Due to some issues, I dropped out for a year, but later on managed to complete my program within a span of 3 years.
For me NMIMS online MBA was up to the mark and met all my expectations. However, there is a little scope for improvement, but overall, I had a good experience.
I recently graduated from the NMIMS online MBA program, and it is a worthwhile option due to its minimal interaction with faculty and self paced learning facility.
The online MBA course at Narsee Monjee also offers career services that I liked the most, and on behalf of it, I recommend it to others too.

faqs.question: What are the admission requirements for the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management program?
faqs.answer: The admission requirements for the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management program are a valid graduation with at least 50% marks.

faqs.question: How long does it take to complete the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management?
faqs.answer: It takes 2 years to complete the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management however, you can complete the course in a maximum of 4 years.

faqs.question: What topics are covered in the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management curriculum?
faqs.answer: The topics covered in the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management curriculum are Manpower Planning, Recruitment and Selection, Organisational Development & Change, Learning & Development, Emotional Intelligence, etc.

faqs.question: Can I balance the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management with my full-time job?
faqs.answer: With the self-paced study and learn anytime, anywhere assistance, you can easily balance the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management with a full-time job.

faqs.question: What career opportunities are available after completing the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management?
faqs.answer: The career opportunities available after completing the NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management include HR Manager, Performance Management Specialist, Talent Acquisition Specialist, etc.

data.eligibility_content:
The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS online MBA course are as follows:

The interested candidate must have completed a bachelor's degree with a 10+2+3 educational qualification from a recognized university.

The applicant must have scored a minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the graduation level (45% for reserved category students, SC/ST/OBC/PwD).
data.admission_steps:
To enroll in the NMIMS online MBA course, follow the below listed step-by-step admission process for a hassle-free enrollment procedure:

Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS Online and register.

Step 2. Complete the registration process to receive credentials to access the admission portal.

Step 3. Start filling out the application form with accurate information.

Step 4. Attach the supporting documents and submit the NMIMS online MBA application form.

Step 5. The university will verify the application form, documents, and fee.

Step 6. Once the verification is completed, the university will issue a "student number" and dispatch your study kit along with the activation of the student portal and LMS.

The course is designed to equip students with the ability to align talent management with the organizational vision, aiming at the development of a world-class workforce. The NMIMS online MBA in human resource management is taught by renowned academicians from IITs, IIMs, and industry veterans.

To make the NMIMS online MBA in HRM ideal for candidates involved in other responsibilities or working professionals, the course offers access to ed-tech learning methodologies via a strong LMS (Learning Management System). Students can learn at their own pace with the digital e-learning platform and resources available 24*7 at their preferred time and place.

data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

data.syllabus_content:
Being a postgraduate degree course, the NMIMS online MBA in human resource management has a duration of 2 years, consisting of 4 semesters. The initial two semesters follow the core course of management and business administration, whereas the third and fourth semester has specialization-specific core courses. The detailed syllabus is mentioned below for better understanding.

Year I

Semester I

  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics & Macro Economics
  • Organisational Behaviour
  • Marketing Management
  • Quantitative Methods – I

Semester II

  • Cost & Management Accounting
  • Human Resource Management
  • Strategic Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Legal Aspect of Business
  • Operations Management

Year II

Semester III

  • Corporate Finance
  • Research Methodology
  • Project Pre-work
  • Compensation & Benefits
  • Industrial Relations & Labour Laws
  • Manpower Planning, Recruitment and Selection
  • Organisational Development & Change

Semester IV

  • Indian Ethos & Ethics
  • Corporate Sustainability
  • International Business
  • Project
  • Performance Management System
  • Learning & Development
  • Emotional Intelligence
